title: On symmetric systems of transport equations
summary: We study a symmetric system of transport equations with solenoidal coefficients. This system reduces to an evolutionary equation with a skew-symmetric spatial operator in the real Hilbert space of square-integrable vector-functions, and by general results we claim that there always exists a generalized solution of the Cauchy problem. Uniqueness of this solution is equivalent to skew-adjointness of the spatial operator.
